Le Petit Voyeur Issue 3

2015

About This Issue

Issue 3 features work from over 35 artists spanning visual art, street art, and photography disciplines. This volume includes a special 16-page Vaughn Bode insert printed on Munken Pure Rough 90 g/m² paper.

Cover artwork by Richard Kern.

Edition:1000 numbered copies

Featured Artists (35+)
